definitions.explanation: The period of time around 12 o'clock at night, or the deepest part of the night.

examples.japanese: {真夜中|まよなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {真夜中|まよなか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{真夜中|まよなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {真夜中|まよなか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だった。
examples.english: The town was quiet in the middle of the night.
I woke up in the middle of the night, and when I looked outside, it was snowing.

notes:
{真夜中|まよなか} refers to the middle of the night - either midnight specifically or the late night hours in general.

FORMS:
{真|ま} (true/middle) + ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧ (nighttime) = the very middle of the night

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {真夜中|まよなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to wake up in the middle of the night
- {真夜中|まよなか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until midnight
- {真夜中|まよなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: past midnight

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧: during the night (general)
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧: late at night (formal, often used for TV schedules)
- ⟦{午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}→午前零時：25594_gozenreiji⟧: exactly 12:00 AM
- ⟦{未明|みめい}→未明：27573_mimei⟧: before dawn (news term)

USAGE:
Unlike ⟦{午前零時|ごぜんれいじ}→午前零時：25594_gozenreiji⟧, {真夜中|まよなか} is flexible and can refer to any time when it feels like the "dead of night."

cross_references.label: early evening, early part of the night
